name: agent-communications
description: Communication tools for coding agents: Gmail, Slack, Resend and WhatsApp. Search, read, analyse, draft and organise mail across several mailboxes, read and post to Slack workspaces, read and send through a Resend team, and read WhatsApp on a Mac — nothing is sent or posted without your approval, and nothing sends on WhatsApp at all.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Gmail and Slack for coding agents. The Gmail server is included: search, read, analyse, draft and organise mail, with sending behind your approval. The Slack skills read a workspace and post only what a person approves; connect their server with `npx -y @agentcomms/slack mcp install --client claude-code` (or `--client` codex, cursor, gemini, claude-desktop or vscode), a registration you approve. The Resend skills read a team's domains and mail and send only what a person approves; connect an account at your terminal with `npx -y @agentcomms/resend account add acme/resend`, and its server with `npx -y @agentcomms/resend mcp install --client claude-code`. The WhatsApp skill reads the chats WhatsApp for Mac keeps on this Mac and drafts replies as links you send — it never sends; add the account at your terminal with `npx -y @agentcomms/whatsapp add personal/whatsapp`, and its server with `npx -y @agentcomms/whatsapp mcp install --client claude-code --account personal/whatsapp`. The onboarding skill works through the core server, which the plugin does not start either: `npx -y @agentcomms/core mcp install --client claude-code`.
